requirements.text: FULL STACK DEVELOPER needed at one of our credit focused $20b hedge fund clients!!! Hybrid 1 - 2 days a week in NYC only. Total comp $175k - $225k. This is a full time salaried role but will be set up as a consulting agreement and there will be no benefits. Must have financial markets experience, especially within credit as well as experience with trading/portfolio management systems. Relevant middle and back end engineering experience is required, with the front end ideally as well. No C2C - this is a direct hire and you will be required to meet them in person during the interview process.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field (Master's welcome); 5+ years' full-stack development on the Microsoft platform.

• Software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, concurrency, distributed systems; microservices and event-driven applications (Kafka, Confluent, or Azure Event Hubs a plus).

• Middle tier: C# and .NET 8+ (ASP.NET Core Web APIs, MVC, Windows/background services); Entity Framework Core, dependency injection, authentication/authorization (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra ID), REST design. Python (pandas, NumPy, SQL data access) to build, maintain, and troubleshoot the portfolio management team's tools and analytics.

• Middle tier: C# and .NET 8+ (ASP.NET Core Web APIs, MVC, Windows/background services); Entity Framework Core, dependency injection, authentication/authorization (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra ID), REST design. Python (pandas, NumPy, SQL data access) to build, maintain, and troubleshoot the portfolio management team's tools and analytics.

• Back end and data: SQL Server and T-SQL (schema design, normalization, indexing, query tuning, stored procedures, large data volumes); PostgreSQL and Redis; Power BI; ETL and data pipeline design; Excel and VBA.

• DevOps and cloud: Git (GitHub or Bitbucket), branching, pull requests, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions); Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, Key Vault, Storage) a strong plus; AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Datadog (monitoring) also valued.

• DevOps and cloud: Git (GitHub or Bitbucket), branching, pull requests, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions); Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, Key Vault, Storage) a strong plus; AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Datadog (monitoring) also valued.

• Financial services experience, especially credit markets: credit instruments (corporate bonds, loans, CDS, credit indices), Equity options and derivates, Interest rate options and derivatives, relative value strategies, pricing, spreads and accruals, security identifiers, fund-administrator reconciliation.

• Front-office trading, portfolio management, pricing, or risk technology: trade lifecycle, positions, P&L, DV01, CS01, scenario analytics, quantitative analytics, financial data processing; integrations with data providers, fund administrators, and order/portfolio management systems such as Enfusion, Bloomberg, Tradeweb, or MarketAxess a plus.

• Participate in the full SDLC (requirements, design, estimation, coding, code review, testing, deployment, support); write unit and integration tests, follow coding and naming standards, and contribute to CI/CD and production monitoring.

• Partner with business stakeholders, portfolio managers, traders, quants, and risk teams to turn requirements into maintainable solutions and conduct ad hoc analysis of operational issues; build and support Python-based tools, analytics, and data workflows.

• Highly motivated, resourceful self-starter with an appetite for knowledge; manages multiple projects with attention to detail, time management, and organization (sets and meets priorities); identifies complex problems and develops, evaluates, and implements solutions.
